customer_id.meaning: primary reference number of the member profile (content hash)

full_name.meaning: member's full legal name as given at signup; not used as a verification credential since a name is easily known by others

phone_number.meaning: the mobile number on file for the member; a verification credential

email.meaning: the email address on file for the member; a verification credential

date_of_birth.meaning: the member's date of birth as recorded from their photo id at signup; a verification credential and the basis for age-gated tiers

photo_id_last4.meaning: the last 4 digits of the government photo id number scanned at signup; a verification credential

member_since_date.meaning: the date this profile was first opened at any club in the chain; a verification credential

home_club_id.meaning: the club location the member most recently designated as their home club (foreign key -> clubs); not a verification credential, staff can see it on any visit

club_id.meaning: primary reference number of the club location record

club_name.meaning: the official signage name of the club location

metro_zone.meaning: the metro area zone this club sits in, used to describe multi-club access footprints

is_24_hour.meaning: whether this specific club location keeps 24-hour access hours

has_pool.meaning: whether this specific club location has a swimming pool amenity

membership_id.meaning: primary reference number of the membership contract

variant_name.meaning: the membership tier held, written as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership contract

home_club_id.meaning: the club this membership is registered to as its home club (foreign key -> clubs); governs single-club access tiers

opened_date.meaning: date the membership was signed up / activated

closed_date.meaning: date the membership was closed; empty while still open

dues_balance.meaning: current net amount the member owes on this membership (positive = owed); identically the running sum of membership_dues_balance_account deltas

guest_passes_remaining.meaning: complimentary guest visits still available in the current billing cycle; identically the running sum of guest_pass_account deltas

freeze_start_date.meaning: date the current or most recent freeze began; empty if never frozen

freeze_end_date.meaning: scheduled date the current freeze is due to end; empty unless a freeze is active

past_due_since_date.meaning: date the membership was marked past_due; empty unless currently past_due; the anchor for the past-due grace period

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the membership ledger row

membership_id.meaning: the membership contract this row belongs to (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which membership ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount of a charge, payment or waiver; 0.00 for rows that carry no dollar amount

charge_type.meaning: the billing subtype of a membership_dues_charge row; blank for other event types

billing_cycle_month.meaning: the billing cycle a recurring dues charge belongs to; blank for one-time or non-billing rows

club_id.meaning: the club a guest visit occurred at (foreign key -> clubs); blank for rows unrelated to a club visit

guest_name.meaning: the name of the guest checked in under a guest visit, as stated at the front desk; blank for rows that are not a guest visit

cancellation_request_id.meaning: primary reference number of the cancellation request

customer_id.meaning: the member requesting cancellation (foreign key -> customers)

membership_id.meaning: the membership contract the request applies to (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

requested_effective_date.meaning: the date the cancellation is scheduled to take effect once the notice period is served

outcome.meaning: current disposition of the cancellation request

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

pt_holding_id.meaning: primary reference number of the personal-training package

variant_name.meaning: the personal-training package tier held, written as the official tier name

closed_date.meaning: date the package was closed; empty while still open

expiration_date.meaning: date unused sessions in this package expire

sessions_remaining.meaning: coaching sessions still available in this package; identically the running sum of pt_session_account deltas

assigned_trainer_name.meaning: the name of the trainer currently assigned to this package

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the personal-training ledger row

pt_holding_id.meaning: the package this row belongs to (foreign key -> pt_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which personal-training ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

sessions_delta.meaning: the signed change in sessions_remaining this row causes

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount refunded on this row; 0.00 when no money moves

session_type.meaning: the kind of coaching session a redemption or cancellation applied to

trainer_name.meaning: the trainer named on this row (the session's trainer, or the newly assigned trainer for a reassignment)

class_pass_id.meaning: primary reference number of the class-credit pack

variant_name.meaning: the class-credit pack tier held, written as the official tier name

closed_date.meaning: date the pack was closed; empty while still open

expiration_date.meaning: date unused credits in this pack expire

credits_remaining.meaning: class credits still available in this pack; identically the running sum of class_credit_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the class-fitness ledger row

class_pass_id.meaning: the pack this row belongs to (foreign key -> class_pass_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which class-fitness ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

credits_delta.format: signed integer count of class credits
credits_delta.meaning: the signed change in credits_remaining this row causes

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount of a no-show fee or refund; 0.00 when no money moves

class_type.meaning: the studio class type this row concerns

club_id.meaning: the club the class is held at (foreign key -> clubs)

class_session_id.meaning: the specific scheduled class session this row concerns; correlates a booking to its later cancellation, no-show or waitlist promotion

enrollment_id.meaning: primary reference number of the corporate wellness enrollment

variant_name.meaning: the employer's corporate wellness partnership tier, written as the official tier name

employer_name.meaning: the name of the employer sponsoring this enrollment, as given by the employee

employer_account_id.meaning: the employer's corporate wellness account reference number (foreign key grouping every employee enrolled under the same employer)

closed_date.meaning: date the enrollment was closed; empty while still open

corporate_dues_balance.meaning: current net amount billed to the employer's master account for this employee's enrollment (positive = owed); identically the running sum of corporate_dues_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the corporate wellness ledger row

enrollment_id.meaning: the enrollment this row belongs to (foreign key -> corporate_wellness_enrollments)

event_type.meaning: which corporate wellness ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount of the billing, payment or waiver

billing_cycle_month.meaning: the billing cycle a dues-billed row belongs to; blank for non-recurring rows

employer_account_id.meaning: the employer's corporate wellness account this row settles against (foreign key -> corporate_wellness_enrollments.employer_account_id)

credit_account_id.meaning: primary reference number of the pro-shop store-credit account

variant_name.meaning: the store-credit account tier held, written as the official tier name

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed; empty while still open

credit_balance.meaning: current spendable store credit balance; identically the running sum of store_credit_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the store-credit ledger row

credit_account_id.meaning: the account this row belongs to (foreign key -> retail_credit_accounts)

event_type.meaning: which store-credit ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

amount_usd.meaning: signed dollar amount of the top-up, redemption, refund or expiration

purchase_item.meaning: the pro-shop item or items named by the member/staff for a redemption row; blank for other event types

channel.meaning: how the transaction was initiated; auto marks an automatic reload

addon_id.meaning: primary reference number of the household add-on membership

customer_id.meaning: the primary/anchor member this add-on is attached to (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the household add-on relationship tier, written as the official tier name

dependent_name.meaning: the full name of the household dependent covered by this add-on

dependent_date_of_birth.meaning: the dependent's date of birth; the basis for age-out conversion

closed_date.meaning: date the add-on was closed; empty while still open

addon_dues_balance.meaning: current net amount owed on this add-on (positive = owed); identically the running sum of addon_dues_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the household add-on ledger row

addon_id.meaning: the add-on this row belongs to (foreign key -> household_addon_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which household add-on ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount of the charge, payment or waiver

billing_cycle_month.meaning: the billing cycle a recurring dues charge belongs to; blank for one-time rows

charge_type.meaning: the billing subtype of an addon_dues_charge row; blank for other event types

locker_rental_id.meaning: primary reference number of the locker rental contract

variant_name.meaning: the locker tier rented, written as the official tier name

club_id.meaning: the club the locker is physically located at (foreign key -> clubs)

locker_number.meaning: the physical locker number assigned at that club

closed_date.meaning: date the rental was closed; empty while still open

rental_balance.meaning: current net amount owed on this rental (positive = owed); identically the running sum of locker_dues_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the locker rental ledger row

locker_rental_id.meaning: the rental this row belongs to (foreign key -> locker_rental_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which locker rental ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount of the charge, payment or waiver

charge_type.meaning: the billing subtype of a locker_fee_charged row; blank for other event types

billing_cycle_month.meaning: the billing cycle a recurring monthly fee belongs to; blank for one-time fees

day_pass_id.meaning: primary reference number of the day/trial pass

variant_name.meaning: the pass tier purchased, written as the official tier name

club_id.meaning: the club the pass was purchased at / is valid at (foreign key -> clubs)

sponsor_employer_account_id.meaning: for a Corporate Guest Pass, the sponsoring employer's corporate wellness account reference number (foreign key -> corporate_wellness_enrollments.employer_account_id); blank for every other tier

valid_from_date.meaning: first date the pass may be used

valid_until_date.meaning: last date the pass may be used

closed_date.meaning: date the pass was closed; empty while still open

visits_remaining.meaning: visits still available on this pass; identically the running sum of day_pass_visit_account deltas

event_id.meaning: primary reference number of the day/trial pass ledger row

day_pass_id.meaning: the pass this row belongs to (foreign key -> day_pass_holdings)

event_type.meaning: which day/trial pass ledger event this row records

event_timestamp.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
event_timestamp.meaning: moment this ledger row was recorded

visits_delta.meaning: the signed change in visits_remaining this row causes

amount_usd.meaning: dollar amount refunded on this row; 0.00 when no money moves

club_id.meaning: the club a visit was used at (foreign key -> clubs)

verification_id.meaning: primary reference number of the identity verification record

verified.meaning: whether identity verification currently passes (monotonically non-decreasing)

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt that set this value

handoff_id.meaning: primary reference number of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
